title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Work Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Report To : JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader

Business Type : Cross-border Industrial Supply Chain / MRO Industrial Products Procurement & Sales

I. Business Introduction

JD Industrial is the core business segment of JD Group focusing on industrial supply chain technology and services. We have established a localized operation system in Brazil , focusing on providing end-to-end MRO industrial product supply chain solutions for Chinese-funded overseas enterprises and local large-scale manufacturing/energy/infrastructure enterprises.

  • Core Positioning : Serve customers in Brazil's manufacturing, energy, mining, infrastructure and other industries, providing one-stop procurement, cross-border/local fulfillment, inventory management, supply chain finance and other services for full-category MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) industrial products.
  • Core Advantages : Relying on JD's global supply chain network, local warehousing, distribution and compliance capabilities in Brazil , and digital procurement platform, we solve the pain points of the Brazilian market such as high prices, long delivery times, scattered suppliers and complex certifications .
  • Business Scope : Covering full MRO categories including tools, labor protection, electrical, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, and spare parts , supporting the dual model of cross-border procurement + local procurement , and realizing fast delivery, compliant customs clearance and credit period settlement in Brazil.

II. Key Job Responsibilities

1. Development and Management of Local MRO Suppliers in Brazil (Core)

  • In-depth development of local MRO suppliers in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.), and establishment of a localized supplier resource pool.
  • Responsible for supplier access, evaluation, negotiation, signing, maintenance and elimination, and building a hierarchical supplier system (head/potential/long-tail).
  • Familiar with the price system, certification requirements (INMETRO), delivery time, credit period and payment habits (OA 90 days, letter of credit installments) of the Brazilian MRO market.

2. MRO Category Procurement and Cost Management

  • Responsible for the full-category MRO procurement in Brazil, undertaking customer needs, and completing the entire process of inquiry, price comparison, negotiation, order placement, fulfillment, reconciliation and settlement.
  • Formulate category procurement strategies, price systems and cost targets, optimize procurement costs, and improve price competitiveness, gross profit and inventory turnover.
  • Analyze the supply and demand, competitors, prices, delivery times and policies of the Brazilian MRO market, and formulate category planning, commodity structure and stock-up strategies.

3. Customer Demand Connection and Solution Output

  • Connect with local Chinese-funded/large-scale enterprise customers in Brazil, explore MRO procurement needs, and provide one-stop procurement solutions, cost optimization, delivery guarantee and inventory management.
  • Coordinate the entire link of cross-border procurement, local procurement, customs clearance, logistics fulfillment and local delivery to ensure timely, compliant and low-cost delivery.
  • Maintain customer relationships, improve repurchase rate, satisfaction and penetration rate, and promote large customer signing, project landing and category expansion.

4. Supply Chain Operation and Data Management

  • Responsible for the entire link operation of MRO inventory, orders, delivery, reconciliation and settlement, ensuring healthy inventory, timely delivery, compliant credit period and fund safety.
  • Track data such as sales, procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time, and output weekly/monthly/analysis reports to support business decisions.
  • Coordinate with JD Industrial's global procurement, cross-border logistics, digital systems, risk control and compliance teams to ensure coordinated, efficient and compliant business operations.

5. Compliance and Risk Management

  • Familiar with Brazilian compliance requirements such as import tariffs, INMETRO certification, commodity inspection, customs declaration, taxation, foreign exchange and labor laws, ensuring that procurement and delivery are legal and compliant.
  • Control supplier risks, price risks, delivery risks, inventory risks, fund risks and compliance risks.

III. Job Requirements

1. Core Competencies (Must-Have)

  • Local MRO Supplier Resources in Brazil : Must have local MRO industrial product supplier resources in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.).
  • MRO Procurement Professional Ability : 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement experience in Brazil/Latin America, familiar with MRO categories, products, prices, certifications, delivery times, credit periods and procurement processes.
  • In-depth Understanding of the Brazilian Market : Familiar with Brazil's industrial market, customer structure, supplier ecology, price system, certification (INMETRO), tariffs, foreign exchange and payment habits.

2. Professional Skills

  • Business Negotiation : Strong ability in price negotiation, negotiation, contract signing and supplier management.
  • Cost and Data Analysis : Price-sensitive, strong cost awareness, proficient in analyzing procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time data.
  • Language Ability : Fluent in Portuguese (native/business level), proficient in English; fluent in Chinese is preferred.
  • Office Tools : Proficient in Excel, PPT, Word and ERP/procurement systems.

3. Comprehensive Quality

  • Business Thinking : Possess the ability of category operation, cost control, profit orientation and inventory management.
  • Customer Orientation : Customer-first, strong service awareness, demand exploration, solution output and customer maintenance.
  • Pressure Resistance and Execution : Result-oriented, strong pressure resistance, strong execution, cross-departmental collaboration and rapid implementation.
  • Compliance and Integrity : Integrity and self-discipline, strong compliance awareness, risk control and high professional quality.

4. Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above , major in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is preferred.
  • 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement/sales experience in Brazil/Latin America; experience in local Brazilian supplier resources, Chinese-funded enterprise services and cross-border procurement is preferred.

IV. What We Offer

  • International Platform : JD Industrial's global business, with collaboration between the local Brazilian team and the China headquarters.
  • Salary and Benefits : Highly competitive salary + performance bonus + annual bonus + local Brazilian social security + commercial insurance + paid annual leave + overseas subsidies.
  • Development Space : Promotion paths such as MRO Category Manager, Regional Procurement & Sales Director, and JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader.
  • Localization Support : Local office in Brazil, local team, compliance support, supply chain support and customer resources.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:

title: Consultor SAP HCM TM
description:
Join us on a journey of endless possibilities

At Strada, possibility isn’t just a promise – it’s the foundation of everything we do. We believe in unlocking potential for every colleague, creating a journey of growth, discovery, and impact.

With the support, resources, and opportunities we provide, you’ll build a fulfilling future – working on meaningful projects that span industries and regions, contributing to outcomes that matter.

Strada is a people, payroll, and technology leader simplifying international workforce management. Operating in 180+ countries, we design and deliver people-first solutions powered by cloud-based technology – helping organizations grow and enabling workforces to perform at their best.

Learn more at

About the Role

Strada is looking for a highly skilled Senior SAP Time Consultant with solid experience in SAP Time Management implementation and support. The ideal candidate will lead time-related functional workstreams, provide expert-level guidance to clients, and deliver high‑quality solutions aligned with HR and Payroll processes.

This role requires strong analytical skills, the ability to work closely with global teams (particularly in Europe), and proven experience delivering AMS and project services in complex environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the analysis, design, configuration, and implementation of SAP Time Management (PT) solutions, including schemas, rules, and work schedules.
  • Provide expert support for Time Evaluation , Absence/Attendance Management , Shift Planning , and Interfaces with Payroll .
  • Conduct requirement-gathering workshops with global stakeholders and convert business needs into functional specifications.
  • Perform enhancements, testing (unit, regression, integration), and documentation according to Strada's delivery standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex time evaluation issues and propose optimized solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across SAP HCM, SuccessFactors, and Payroll.
  • Support AMS operations by handling incidents, service requests, and minor enhancements with SLA compliance.
  • Train users and junior consultants; provide guidance on best practices and process improvements.
  • Ensure alignment with Strada’s governance model, delivery framework, and quality methodologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, HR Information Systems, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in SAP Time Management consulting.
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Time Evaluation schemas and PCRs
  • Absence/Attendance configuration
  • Work schedules, public holidays, and time quotas
  • Integrations with Payroll (SAP HCM or EC Payroll)
  • Experience working in international/multicultural delivery teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Poruguese and English languages are a must to have.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SuccessFactors Employee Central Time Off or Workforce Software is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of AMS delivery models (ITIL, incident lifecycle management).
  • SAP certification in HCM Time Management is a plus.
  • Experience supporting European time schemas (Spain, Italy, France, UK, etc.) is highly desirable.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with global clients across Europe and the Americas.
  • Flexible work model with team collaboration across time zones.
  • Professional growth within a high-performing SAP and Cloud consulting environment.
  • Competitive compensation and clear career development path.

At Strada, our values guide everything we do:

  • Anticipate Customer Needs – We stay ahead of trends so our customers can grow and succeed.
  • Own the Outcome – We take responsibility for delivering excellence and ensuring things get done right.
  • Challenge Ourselves to Work Smarter – We move faster than the world around us to drive change and accomplish more.
  • Empower Each Other to Solve Problems – We tackle challenges head on, ask tough questions, and collaborate to find the best solutions.
  • Care About Our Work and Our People – We understand that what we do impacts millions, and we have a responsibility to get it right.

Benefits

At Strada, we support your whole self—offering a range of benefits for your health, wellbeing, finances, and future. These include health coverage, wellbeing programs, paid leave (vacation, sick, parental), retirement plans, learning opportunities, and more.

All offers are contingent on successful completion of background checks, where permitted by law and as appropriate for the role. These may include identity, education, employment, and in some cases, criminal history verification, checks against global watchlists, credit reports, and/or drug testing. You’ll be informed of the specific checks applicable to your role and location during the recruitment process.

Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Strada is dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We believe that embracing differences strengthens our teams and drives innovation and success.

Diversity Policy Statement

Strada is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination based on legally protected characteristics. We actively support the advancement of underrepresented groups and provide reasonable accommodations for disabilities and religious practices. Applicants may request a reasonable accommodation by contacting their recruiter.

Authorization to work in the Employing Country

To be considered, you must have current and future work authorization in the country where you're applying, without the need for visa sponsorship by Strada.

Please note: This job description does not limit Strada’s right to assign or reassign responsibilities, including to subsidiaries, partners, or future business purchasers.

title: SAP GRC Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema

Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.

Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.

In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.

Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.

What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento em linguagens de banco de dados (SQL, NoSQL, Oracle), incluindo criação de queries, procedures e scripts.

  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Tratamos os seus dados de acordo com a LGPD, Lei nº 13.709/2018 e respeitamos a sua privacidade. Em caso de dúvidas, veja a nossa Política de Privacidade (inserir o link: ).

title: Pre-Sales Consultant - Physical AI - Brazil
description:
We are seeking a technically fluent Pre-Sales Consultant to join our Physical AI Solutions team. In this role you will serve as the connective tissue between prospective customers and our delivery organization, translating complex robotics and autonomous-systems requirements into compelling, commercially viable solution proposals. You will work across our three core service lines ADAS Data Collection & Labeling, Robotics Data Collection & Labeling, Computer Vision data solutions to shape deals that accelerate the development of ADAS systems, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real transfer pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

• Solution Design & Scoping: Partner with prospects to understand their robotics model-training pipelines (VLM pre-training, VLA fine-tuning, RL alignment) and design data collection & labeling solutions that map to each stage.

• Technical Discovery: Lead technical discovery sessions covering sensor modalities (LiDAR, radar, camera, IMU), annotation taxonomies (3D bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, 6-DoF pose), and simulation requirements (Isaac Sim, Real2Sim asset creation).

• Proposal Development: Author technical proposals, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses that articulate data pipelines, quality frameworks, tooling (e.g., proprietary labeling platforms), and delivery timelines.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams to validate feasibility, refine pricing models, and ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to production.

• Market Intelligence: Stay current on robotics industry trends, foundation models, sim-to-real transfer, egocentric AI, 3D kinematics, reinforcement learning and feed insights back into go-to-market strategy.

• Customer Presentations & Demos: Develop and deliver tailored presentations, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and workshop sessions for technical and executive audiences.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.

• Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.

• Experience with at least two of: LiDAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3D reconstruction, or simulation environments.

• Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.

• Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.

• Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.

• Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).

• Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.

• Master’s degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.

What We Offer

• A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.

• Competitive base salary.

• Comprehensive benefits package.

• Flexible remote-first culture.

**At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. Please send us your complete resume in English.

title: Growth Analyst | Internship
description:
O que a Liora faz

O Brasil tem um mercado de energia elétrica de R$ 300 bilhões por ano. A maioria das pessoas paga a conta todo mês sem questionar o valor, sem entender as opções e sem receber nada em troca além do serviço básico. A Liora muda essa equação.

A gente transforma a conta de luz em um produto financeiro — com cashback real, acesso a crédito e uma experiência que faz sentido para quem usa. O cliente economiza, a gente cresce, e o dinheiro que antes ficava parado numa conta de concessionária começa a circular de volta pra vida das pessoas.

Não é uma ideia. Em três meses de 2026 já dobramos de tamanho. A projeção é crescer 15x até dezembro. Temos backing de Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital — fundos que apostam em empresas com potencial de redefinir mercados inteiros. Se você quer entender como uma empresa assim é construída por dentro, essa vaga é o caminho mais curto.

Desafio

O mercado de energia é complexo, muito regulado e historicamente resistente à mudança. Isso significa que a maioria dos brasileiros ainda não sabe que pode escolher de onde vem sua energia — e os que sabem, muitas vezes não confiam em quem oferece.

Escalar num mercado assim exige mais do que anúncio bem feito — exige entender o que faz uma pessoa confiar, decidir e agir. Quem entrar nessa vaga vai trabalhar exatamente nisso: entender o que quebra a resistência do cliente, o que gera conversão de verdade e como transformar esse aprendizado num processo que escala.

Meta/Google Ads, Metabase, SQL, Python, N8N e Sheets são apenas ferramentas. O trabalho real é entender por que algo funciona — e saber replicar isso em escala sem perder a eficiência.

Por que essa vaga é diferente

A maioria das vagas "de marketing" te coloca pra promover posts, reportar métricas e esperar aprovação de três camadas hierárquicas. Essa não.

Você vai sentar do lado de quem toma decisão desde o primeiro mês. Vai ter acesso aos números reais da empresa — CAC, LTV, taxa de conversão por canal, por criativo, por oferta. Vai propor experimentos, defender sua lógica e ver o resultado aparecer em tempo real. É o tipo de exposição que a maioria das pessoas leva anos pra conseguir. Aqui você tem isso desde o começo.

Perfil que buscamos

Você não precisa ter experiência em marketing, em energia ou em nenhuma área específica. Você precisa:

  • Gostar de números de verdade — não só de ler dashboard, mas de questionar o que está por trás dele.
  • Conseguir pegar um problema confuso e quebrar em partes que podem ser testadas
  • Ter mais curiosidade do que certeza, e mais disposição pra errar rápido do que medo de estar errado
  • Ser ambicioso no sentido real da palavra — alguém que pensa em construir algo grande, não só em ter um emprego que paga bem

Se você está na faculdade, querendo mais do que aula teórica, e quer entender como uma empresa de verdade cresce na prática — essa vaga é pra você!

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact; transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .

With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films; it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.

While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!

As our Marketing Specialist, you will lead the development and execution of growth strategies that position Peliplat as a must-try platform for film lovers.

You will create campaigns that spark curiosity, drive engagement, and fuel viral growth—leveraging influencers, community dynamics, and storytelling to scale our global presence.

Performance & Optimization

  • A builder mindset: you don’t just plan, you execute, test, and scale

Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in; it’s how we execute.

We are building more than a platform; we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end mobile test automation frameworks using Selenium and Playwright
  • Define the overall QA strategy including unit, integration, regression, and performance testing
  • Establish test coverage standards and drive adoption across the Android and iOS workstreams
  • Collaborate with the Tech Lead, Android, and iOS developers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD
  • Create, manage, and groom JIRA test-related user stories, defects, and test cycles
  • Lead exploratory and regression testing for major releases
  • Mentor and guide Mid SDETs in automation best practices and framework usage
  • Produce and maintain test reports, dashboards, and quality metrics
  • Identify and escalate risks and quality issues to the Tech Lead and project stakeholders

  • 7+ years of SDET or QA Automation Engineer experience
  • Expert proficiency with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript for test scripting
  • Experience with mobile test automation for Android (Espresso, UIAutomator) and iOS (XCUITest)
  • Proficiency with Appium for cross-platform mobile automation
  • Deep experience managing test cases, defects, and cycles in JIRA (Zephyr or Xray preferred)
  • Hands-on experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitrise)
  • Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum QA processes
  • Expert-level understanding and advocacy of Test Driven Development (TDD) and its application within QA and development workflows
  • Excellent analytical and root cause analysis skills
  • Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
  • Familiarity with mobile performance testing tools (Firebase Test Lab, AWS Device Farm)
  • Knowledge of API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured)
  • Background in accessibility testing for mobile applications

Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Especialista em Tecnologia - Segurança da Informação e IA
description:

  • Habilidades em análise de riscos, gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, comunicar-se efetivamente e liderar projetos;
  • Pensamento crítico, resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.

Diferenciais:

title: Business Development Manager
description:
As a Business Development Manager , you will act as the driving force behind our expansion in Brazil.

You’ll be responsible for building our market presence, developing a portfolio of strategic clients, and leading a team of Junior Business Developers. Your mission is to scale revenue, establish LittleBig as a key player in Brazil, and ensure operational excellence across all activities.

Key Responsibilities

Market Launch & Strategic Growth

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for Brazil
  • Open and grow strategic accounts in targeted industries
  • Adapt LittleBig’s value proposition to local market needs and positioning

Client Development & Key Account Management

  • Drive acquisition of major enterprise clients and expand relationships with existing customers
  • Lead the full commercial cycle: prospecting, RFP responses, proposal creation, and complex negotiations
  • Represent LittleBig at the highest level with C-level and procurement stakeholders

BU Leadership & Team Management

  • Hire, coach, and manage a local team of Junior Business Developers
  • Set performance targets and lead the team to achieve collective goals
  • Instill a high-performance, collaborative, and ownership-driven culture

Talent Network Development & Delivery Oversight

  • Build a local community of freelancers and consulting firms
  • Oversee expert-client matching and mission delivery quality
  • Ensure successful execution from contracting to delivery, supported by internal teams

Performance Tracking & Governance

  • Monitor KPIs: revenue, margin, project pipeline, closing rates, team performance
  • Deliver regular reports and business insights to global leadership

Profile

  • Master’s degree from a top business school, engineering school, or university

  • Proven track record in market development and client acquisition
  • Strong leadership skills and experience in managing high-performing teams
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution capability; data- and result-driven
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English ; French is a plus
  • Solid knowledge of digital tools and B2B sales practices (CRM, automation, AI)

title: Analista Comercial
description:
Analista Comercial Sênior - Sustentabilidade

Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira.

Se é você, adoraríamos conversar.

Sobre o papel

Estamos em busca de um Analista Comercial coleta e analisa dados de vendas e mercado para identificar oportunidades, elabora propostas comerciais e colabora com a equipe de vendas no desenvolvimento de estratégias de captação. Requer formação superior em sustentabilidade, inglês intermediário/avançado, domínio de Office e experiência em vendas, marketing, análise de dados ou ESG.

Sobre o Grupo Bureau Veritas

Fundado em 1828, somos líder mundial em serviços de testes laboratoriais, inspeção e certificação, possuímos mais de 74 mil funcionários em 1.400 escritórios e laboratórios ao redor do globo. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social. Há 190 anos nossa marca é sinônimo de integridade e confiança, em benefício dos negócios e das pessoas, contribuindo para transformar o mundo em que vivemos. Para saber um pouco mais acesse o site

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coletar e analisar dados de vendas e de mercado para identificar tendências e oportunidades de negócio.
  • Analisar e elaborar propostas e apresentações comerciais conforme interesse do cliente e padrões da companhia.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de vendas para desenvolver estratégias eficazes de captação de clientes e novas oportunidades.
  • Fornecer insights e dados que possam ajudar no aprimoramento de propostas e prospecções comerciais.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios de desempenho e análises comparativas.
  • Participar na criação de planos de ação para alcançar os objetivos comerciais.

O que buscamos:

  • Formação Superior completa nas áreas correlacionadas de sustentabilidade;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas a vendas, marketing ou análise de dados.
  • Experiência prévia em projetos e ou formação em sustentabilidade/ESG.

O que nós podemos oferecer:

Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, trabalhando em uma equipe de especialistas. Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios.

Ao participar deste processo de recrutamento & seleção, do Bureau Veritas Brasil, o(a) candidato(a) declara:

  • Estar em condições técnicas e operacionais, no que tange à ergonomia, estação de trabalho e velocidade de conexão internet para desempenhar, quando necessário, o trabalho remoto “home office”;
  • O Bureau Veritas está em conformidade com a Constituição Federal brasileira (no inc. V do seu art. 5o.inc. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Analista de Segurança da Informação e Redes Pleno para integrar nosso time de Infraestrutura de Segurança. Esse profissional será responsável por administrar e evoluir soluções de segurança, identificar e analisar riscos e vulnerabilidades, monitorar continuamente os ambientes e atuar na resposta a incidentes cibernéticos. Sua atuação será fundamental para garantir a proteção dos dados, a integridade dos sistemas e a continuidade dos serviços críticos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Administrar e monitorar soluções de segurança e appliances de rede;
  • Atuar na gestão e troubleshooting de ambientes SD-WAN;
  • Implementar, suportar e evoluir soluções de NAC (Network Access Control);
  • Administrar e manter antivírus corporativo e soluções de EDR/XDR;
  • Realizar análises de risco e vulnerabilidades, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Monitorar continuamente os sistemas de segurança e redes para detectar e responder a incidentes;
  • Investigar e responder a incidentes cibernéticos (phishing, ransomware, violações de dados), elaborando relatórios de causa raiz e recomendações de mitigação;
  • Desenvolver e testar planos de resposta a incidentes e recuperação de desastres (DRP);
  • Apoiar na definição e manutenção de políticas de segurança alinhadas a frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 e COBIT;
  • Documentar procedimentos, configurações e boas práticas de segurança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em soluções de segurança: Firewalls, EDR/XDR, DLP, Antivírus, NAC, WAF, SD-WAN, Proxies, VPNs, IDS/IPS, LAN, WAN, balanceadores de carga, redes em nuvem e ambientes conteinerizados;
  • Habilidade em troubleshooting de firewalls e dispositivos de segurança;
  • Experiência em monitoramento, prevenção e resposta a incidentes;
  • Conhecimento em métodos do ciclo de vida de dados e identidades;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT, ITIL);
  • Administração de servidores Linux e Windows.

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA

ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.

About the Job

ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.

This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development

  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.

Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution

  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.

Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management

  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.

Project Oversight & Value Realization

  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.

What You’ll Need

Experience

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.

Network & Market Knowledge

  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.

Territory Management

  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.

Languages

  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.

Commercial & Strategic Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.

Remote Collaboration

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.

Travel

  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Why Join us?

  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.

*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

title: Arquiteto de CRM Especialista (Salesforce & Dynamics)
description:
O que buscamos?

Você será o maestro de um ecossistema tecnológico robusto, atuando em 4 Verticais de Negócio distintas (Banco, Saúde, Seguros e Serviços), além da estrutura corporativa (Holding). Seu papel central será garantir que o Salesforce (nossa potência de CX, Marketing e CDP) e o Microsoft Dynamics 365 (nosso motor de Vendas) operem em total harmonia, seguindo as boas práticas e padrões de Arquitetura, alinhados aos objetivos de Negócio. Além disso, fará parte do desafio, habilitar soluções para domínios funcionais que atualmente rodam em legados ou tem uma cobertura funcional incompleta, como Atendimento e Fidelização respectivamente.

Se você é apaixonado por padrões de arquitetura, governança de dados e quer deixar um legado de escalabilidade em uma estrutura multi-BU, este lugar é seu.

Atribuições principais:

● Definição de Padrões: Estabelecer o Blueprinting arquitetural corporativo para garantir que as customizações em ambas as plataformas sigam padrões de qualidade e resiliência.

● Entender a cadeia funcional fim a fim de CRM mapeada pelo Arquitetura Corporativo e influenciar conjuntamente/complementarmente com ele a estratégia de Centralidade do Cliente.

● Conhecer de forma consistente o potencial nativo das plataformas para evitar customizações e desenvolvimentos desnecessários.

● Orquestração de Dados: Desenhar as estratégias de interoperabilidade necessária entre a cadeia de CRM (marketing, vendas, atendimento e fidelização) com o ecossistema de Dados Mestres (MDM) que atualmente está parcialmente construído internamente. Além disso, desenhar a estratégia de integração entre o Salesforce CDP e o Dynamics, garantindo a integridade da "Single Source of Truth" (Fonte Única da Verdade).

● Governança Multi Tenant: Atuar como o ponto focal técnico para as 4 BUs, equilibrando necessidades específicas locais com a coesão da arquitetura global.

● Design de Integrações: Definir padrões de comunicação (Assíncrona vs Síncrona, APIs, Webhooks) entre o front-end de atendimento e o back-end de vendas.

● Mentoria e Review: Realizar Design Reviews técnicos para assegurar que as implementações dos parceiros ou times internos não gerem débitos técnicos.

Requisitos:

● Experiência Híbrida: Vivência sólida em projetos complexos de Salesforce (Sales/Service/Marketing Cloud) e Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE.

● Visão de Dados: Conhecimento em estratégias de CDP (Customer Data Platform) e MDM (Master Data Management).

● Padrões de Integração: Domínio de arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e barramentos de integração (MuleSoft, Azure Service Bus, ou similares).

● Soft Skills: Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em soluções técnicas elegantes e negociar com stakeholders de diferentes BUs.

Além disso, algumas competências necessárias para o papel de Arquiteto de Solução:

Flexibilidade e desejo de aprender: Capacidade de ser flexível e se adaptar a novas tecnologias rapidamente, além de desejar aprender coisas novas para trazer propostas e soluções inovadoras.

Habilidades analíticas: Analisar dados e problemas de forma rápida e eficiente para encontrar soluções criativas para problemas complexos.

Aptidão para resolução de problemas: Possuir excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e a capacidade de pensar fora da caixa para quebrar problemas complexos.

Gerenciamento de tempo: Gerenciar o tempo de forma eficaz é essencial para o Arquiteto de Soluções. Freqüentemente, vários fluxos de trabalho estão sendo executados simultaneamente com a necessidade de priorizar tarefas para cumprir marcos e prazos.

Trabalho em equipe: Capacidade para trabalhar e contribuir em equipe, tendo que trabalhar bem com outras pessoas em um ambiente colaborativo.

Nosso jeito de agir é o nosso principal diferencial, por isso, para fazer parte do time procuramos pessoas que sejam curiosas, estejam abertas à mudanças, busquem continuamente novas

soluções e alternativas, mantenham atitudes pró-ativa, compreendam o objetivo a ser alcançado com qualidade e pontualidade e que sejam colaborativas, promovendo feedbacks constantes e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e aprendizado individual e coletivo.

Diferenciais:

Certificações como Salesforce Application/System Architect ou Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect.

● Experiência com Data Cloud (Salesforce) ou integração nativa via Azure Data Factory.

● Mindset de agilidade e experiência em ambientes com governança de TI compartilhada.

Localidade da posição:

title: User Operations Expert
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a User Operations Expert – User Growth to join our Growth team in São Paulo. This role will be responsible for driving end-to-end customer growth strategy , focusing on user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention .

You will play a critical role in building a scalable and sustainable user growth engine , combining data insights, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to unlock new growth opportunities and maximize user lifetime value.

Key Responsibilities

1. User Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Design and execute customer growth strategies across the full funnel (acquisition → activation → retention → loyalty)
  • Develop a structured growth framework based on user lifecycle and behavioral insights
  • Build and continuously optimize a sustainable growth engine aligned with business goals

2. User Segmentation & Retention Strategy

  • Develop and manage a robust user segmentation model (e.g., new, active, dormant, high-value users)
  • Design targeted engagement and retention initiatives to increase stickiness and frequency
  • Drive lifecycle marketing strategies to improve user contribution, loyalty, and long-term value

3. Channel Expansion & Acquisition Optimization

  • Identify and test new user acquisition channels (organic, paid, partnerships, referrals, etc.)
  • Optimize channel performance through continuous experimentation and A/B testing
  • Stay ahead of emerging traffic trends and growth tactics to reach high-quality users

4. Data Analysis & Product Collaboration

  • Analyze user behavior data to identify growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Translate insights into actionable growth initiatives and experiments
  • Partner closely with Product and Tech teams to enhance user experience and product features that drive growth

5. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Data, and Tech teams to align priorities and resources
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to ensure efficient execution of growth projects
  • Act as a key stakeholder in growth-related decision-making and roadmap planning

Requirements

  • Proven experience in User Growth, User Operations, Growth Marketing, or similar roles (preferably in B2C / marketplace / tech environments)
  • Strong understanding of growth frameworks (AARRR, lifecycle management, retention loops)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale user growth strategies from data insights
  • Advanced analytical skills ( SQL or strong data analysis capability is a plus )
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives end-to-end in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

  • Proficient English verbal communication skills

  • Conhecimento geral em SAP, com atuação em múltiplos módulos e visão integrada dos processos;
  • Experiência em análise funcional, com capacidade de entender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em soluções sistêmicas;

  • Boa comunicação para interação com usuários, times técnicos e fornecedores;
  • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir vivência mais aprofundada em governança de AMS e relacionamento com fornecedores;

title: Pharmaceutical Field Specialist
description:
Job title: Field Specialist, Brazil

Job Type: Project-related part-time work (working hours depend on availability, but if you are working on a project, we ask for 1-3 days per week).

Are you looking for something flexible? Do you have sales, marketing or market research experience within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries? Are you interested in joining a fast-paced and growing global organisation?

Job Purpose:

We are looking for a Field Specialist to join our Brazil team. This role will shadow pharmaceutical representatives for the day and prepare a report based on observations made while working with the representative as they interact with their customers. The position is appointment based, depending on the size of the project and number of field days required. The position would be suitable for someone looking for project-related part-time work that leads to a long-term collaboration.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Contacting sales representatives to arrange a shadowing day in the field
  • Observing interactions between sales representatives and customers without disrupting their day (primarily face to face)
  • Conducting a 60–90-minute interview with the sales representative during the field day
  • Submitting structured reports (workbooks), translated into English, after each day in the field based on observations made within 24-48 hours of field visit
  • Attending a 30-60 min online session prior to each project to understand the project objectives and share feedback
  • Participate in project debrief calls and potentially provide feedback to assist in the development of final recommendations

Person Specification:

  • Experience in sales, marketing or market research within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries
  • Fluent command of Portuguese and English (written and oral)
  • Bachelor’s degree – marketing, science, or data focus is preferred
  • When working on a project, have 1-3 days availability during the week
  • Flexibility to work from morning to evening
  • Flexibility to travel within the country
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listener
  • Confident user of Microsoft Excel

Opportunity:

  • Work with a successful and well-established company with an enviable growth trajectory
  • Working with 29 out of top 30 pharmaceutical companies globally
  • Great flexibility in managing the workload and opportunity to travel within the country
  • Structured and on-going training system and working with strong management team

If you would like to apply for this position, please submit your CV in ENGLISH .

About STEM:

STEM Healthcare is a dynamic, fast paced global pharmaceutical and life science, commercial benchmarking firm headquartered in the UK and present across six continents. STEM have developed an audit process and built a benchmarking database with more than 500,000 face-to-face observations completed across 52 countries. The benchmark provided is unique in the pharmaceutical industry consisting of over 100 KPIs, while focusing on 2-3 key priorities during formulation of action planning in order to help clients further accelerate performance.

STEM accelerates performance, improves strategic alignment, and facilitates excellence in marketing, medical, market access and account plans strategy execution. Due to the unique, specialised and highly targeted offering, STEM is experiencing a rapid growth phase, and recruiting heavily across the world. New employees will be joining at a time where rapid career development and growth opportunities are expected, as the organisation works towards their mid and long-term goals.

Vision: To always be viewed as an essential partner in enabling our clients to reach more patients with their medicines

Mission: To accelerate high performance

Core Values: Brave, Honest, Performance Driven, Practical, Customer Focused, Caring

Find us here:

Website:

STEM Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. STEM Healthcare will consider all qualified applicants for employment without discrimination on grounds of disability, sex or sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity leave status, race or national or ethnic origin, age, religion or belief, gender identity or re-assignment, marital or civil partnership status, protected veteran status (if applicable) or any other characteristic protected by law. STEM Healthcare only employs individuals with the right to work in the country/ies where the role is advertised.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. title: Analista de CS - Pleno
description:
Analista de CS

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

  • Definição estratégica: conduzir análises e propor recomendações que suportem decisões de negócio através de um programa de VoC (Voice od Customer);
  • Storytelling executivo: criar materiais que traduzam dados e insights em narrativas estratégicas, com plano de ações das áreas;
  • Capacidade de mapeamento de processos e fluxos de atendimento;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das áreas, garantindo alinhamento entre planejamento e execução, com reuniões recorrentes e reports para COMEX;
  • Acompanhar indicadores chave, identificar riscos e oportunidades e propor ajustes estratégicos;
  • Lidar com múltiplos assuntos com resiliência e comprometimento;

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir análises a partir de dados e feedbacks de clientes, apoiando a evolução do programa de VoC (Voice of Customer).
  • Estruturar e evoluir indicadores de experiência, como NPS e CSAT, incluindo análises e ações de melhoria (close the loop).
  • Criar materiais executivos, traduzindo dados e insights em storytelling claro, com direcionamento de ações para as áreas.
  • Mapear e analisar jornadas, processos e fluxos de atendimento, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e eficiência.
  • Atuar em parceria com áreas de negócio, garantindo alinhamento entre planejamento e execução das iniciativas.
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com stakeholders e preparar reportes executivos para liderança (COMEX).
  • Acompanhar indicadores-chave, identificando riscos e oportunidades e propondo ajustes estratégicos.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como CRM, Excel, PowerPoint, Miro e Tableau para análise, organização e comunicação das iniciativas.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente, mantendo organização, priorização e qualidade nas entregas.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento em metodologias de experiência do cliente, como NPS e CSAT, incluindo análise e práticas de close the loop
  • Experiência em Customer Success ou Relacionamento com Cliente, preferencialmente no setor de seguros
  • Vivência com projetos de Voice of Customer (VoC)
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de construção de narrativas executivas
  • Capacidade de mapear processos, jornadas e fluxos de atendimento
  • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de CRM
  • Perfil consultivo, organizado e orientado a resultados

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Inteligência Artificial aplicada a dados ou experiência do cliente
  • Possuir familiaridade com produtos financeiros e contexto do setor de seguros (B2B)

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno
description:
Sobre nós

Fundada em 1997 na Coreia do Sul e presente em 19 países, a Mirae Asset é um conglomerado financeiro global que oferece soluções de investimento inovadoras para clientes ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, atuamos como corretora de valores, conectando o mercado local a nossa presença internacional e colocando à disposição de investidores pessoas físicas e institucionais produtos e serviços de primeira linha. Nosso compromisso é unir solidez global, inovação e proximidade no atendimento para apoiar nossos clientes em seus objetivos de investimento.

#VemSerMiraeAsset

Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um Analista Sênior em Segurança da Informação para atuar como guardião da resiliência tecnológica da empresa. Alguém com visão holística, que consiga equilibrar práticas tradicionais de defesa com estratégias modernas, automatização e governança sólida. Este é um papel estratégico, com autonomia, responsabilidade e forte interface com áreas de TI e negócios.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em Segurança da Informação (nível sênior).
  • Domínio em gestão de riscos, incidentes e vulnerabilidades.
  • Conhecimento avançado de redes, protocolos, arquitetura e modelos de segurança.
  • Experiência com Azure (Microsoft M365) e AWS em contexto de segurança.
  • Vivência com ferramentas SIEM, EDR/XDR e soluções de proteção de endpoint.
  • Entendimento de LGPD e compliance regulatório aplicável.
  • Experiência com IAM, políticas e controles de acesso.
  • Capacidade de escrever e manter políticas, processos e padrões corporativos.
  • Boa comunicação para se relacionar com tecnologia e negócio sem ruído.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Proatividade e senso de urgência.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade analítica e orientação a solução de problemas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar iniciativas de segurança, garantindo aderência a normas, políticas internas e frameworks de mercado (NIST, CIS, LGPD).
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, análises de vulnerabilidade e propor planos de mitigação eficazes.
  • Realizar Patch Management no Ambiente afim de mitigar vulnerabilidades
  • Coordenar investigações e resposta a incidentes de segurança de ponta a ponta.
  • Desenvolver, revisar e reforçar políticas, padrões e procedimentos de SI.
  • Monitorar eventos e ameaças em ferramentas de SIEM/SOC, apoiando times operacionais e times de infraestrutura.
  • Realizar hardening de sistemas, aplicações, redes e ambientes cloud.
  • Gerir identidade e acesso (IAM), incluindo melhores práticas de MFA, RBAC e segregação de funções.
  • Operar e otimizar ferramentas de segurança: EDR/XDR, WAF, DLP, CASB, Zero Trust e Firewall (IPS e IDS)
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, acompanhando planos de ação.
  • Influenciar cultura de segurança, treinando e sensibilizando áreas de negócio.
  • Avaliar tecnologias emergentes e propor evoluções arquiteturais e de governança.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações: CompTIA Security+.
  • Experiência com Zero Trust, SASE, DevSecOps e segurança em pipelines CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks SRE voltados à segurança.
  • Experiência com automação e scripts (PowerShell, Python, Bash).
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes de fintech, financeiro ou empresas altamente reguladas.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.

Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.

Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.

The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.

This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.

Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.

Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .

Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

Atuar como responsável técnico principal e referência em Segurança da Informação da companhia, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais, a continuidade do negócio, a integridade das informações e a aderência às melhores práticas de mercado, por meio da definição, implementação, operação e evolução contínua dos controles de segurança cibernética.

  • Conhecimento em Azure e Microsoft On-Premise, Cloud AWS e Huawei, Redes, Firewall, VPN, VLAN,SIEM (Splunk), EDR / XDR (CrowdStrike), IAM / PAM, Segurança de aplicações (OWASP).

  • Scale best practices: Align global messaging with LATAM needs; enable knowledge-sharing and consistent activation across countries.

What you bring:

title: Especialista em segurança da informação
description:
VAGA | ESPECIALISTA EM SEGURANÇA DA INFORMAÇÃO

A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 16 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 10.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.

Missão do cargo

Atuar na operação, gestão e evolução da Segurança da Informação, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais, a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas e regulamentos. O profissional será responsável por planejar, executar e monitorar estratégias de segurança, assegurando a confidencialidade, integridade e disponibilidade das informações corporativas.

Principais atribuições

  • Executar funções técnicas de segurança, como análise de segurança, gerenciamento de riscos, testes de penetração e administração de sistemas seguros.
  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar projetos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar estratégias de segurança da informação, alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Atuar na gestão de incidentes de segurança, incluindo investigação, resposta e recuperação.
  • Garantir aderência a regulamentos e normas de segurança e conformidade, como ANPD, GDPR, HIPAA e normas ABNT/ISO.
  • Utilizar e administrar tecnologias e ferramentas de segurança, como firewalls, sistemas de detecção/prevenção de intrusões, antivírus e criptografia.
  • Promover conscientização em segurança da informação, comunicando riscos e boas práticas de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação; ou
  • Conclusão de qualquer curso de nível superior, acompanhada de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) na área de Tecnologia da Informação, com carga mínima de 360 horas, em instituição reconhecida pelo MEC.

Experiência Profissional

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à operação de Segurança da Informação, comprovada por documento expedido por pessoa jurídica de direito público ou privado.

Certificações Obrigatórias

O profissional deverá possuir, no mínimo, 3 (três) das certificações abaixo (ou equivalentes/superiores):

  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE)

✅ Conhecimentos Técnicos Esperados

  • Análise de segurança, gestão de riscos e testes de invasão.
  • Planejamento e gestão de projetos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Normas, leis e regulamentos de segurança e privacidade da informação.
  • Gestão de incidentes, investigação forense e recuperação de ambientes.
  • Ferramentas e tecnologias de segurança (firewalls, IDS/IPS, antivírus, criptografia).

description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.

If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.

But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.

What You’ll Own

  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of SaaS marketing experience (SMB-focused)
  • 3+ years specializing in product marketing at a fast-moving SaaS company
  • Proven success owning end-to-end product marketing campaigns — from idea to impact
  • Deep experience with in-app messaging apps, such as, AppCues
  • Strong analytical mindset — you track KPIs, act on insights, and prioritize what moves the numbers
  • Sharp communicator, listener, and writer with a strategic mind and bias for execution
  • Self-directed operator who doesn’t need hand-holding to deliver results
  • Detail-oriented, process-driven, and KPI-aware
  • Self-starter mindset — you Google before you ask, and always show up with solutions
  • Process-oriented team player who can document, scale, and systemize efforts
  • Team player, highly coachable, and positive attitude — always
  • Able to work U.S. time zones, full-time

✨ Bonus Points

  • Experience in marketing to real estate professionals
  • Background in direct-response copywriting

⚡️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays
  • High autonomy, fast execution, and a CMO who actually values great marketing
  • Full ownership over your work — real impact, not just tickets
  • Professional development benefit
  • Health & wellness benefit
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don’t Apply If:

  • You don’t meet the minimum product marketing experience
  • You’ve never run a product marketing campaign from start to finish
  • No experience working for a SaaS company
  • You need micromanagement or daily check-ins to be productive
  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You’re not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams

Ready to grow with us?

We’re looking for a proven product marketer ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that’s you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Especialista de Segurança da Informação
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Especialista de Segurança da Informação (Blue Team) com perfil técnico e estratégico, responsável por fortalecer as defesas cibernéticas da organização. Este profissional atuará diretamente na identificação, análise e resposta a incidentes de segurança, além de propor e implementar melhorias contínuas para mitigação de riscos. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Monitorar ambientes, identificando e mitigando ameaças em tempo real;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de tecnologia para integrar segurança aos processos e sistemas da empresa;
  • Atuar como referência técnica em cibersegurança, apoiando decisões e implementação de novas soluções;
  • Desenvolver e disseminar boas práticas de segurança, promovendo treinamentos e capacitação de equipes;
  • Implementar, administrar e otimizar ferramentas de segurança como Firewalls, EDR, VPN, IDS/IPS, entre outras;
  • Realizar análise de riscos, modelagem de ameaças e implementar melhorias contínuas com base em TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos);

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;

  • Experiência com troubleshooting avançado em dispositivos e soluções de segurança;
  • Conhecimento em automação de processos e ferramentas SOAR (ex.: Ansible, Python);
